name: llm in chrome
tagline: An open-source browser agent like Claude in Chrome that works with any LLM.

awards: Deck - Sponsor Challenge // Deck - Défi commandité

problem: Browser agents are tied to one model provider.
solution: A Chrome extension agent that operates web pages with a model of the user's choice.
demo_moment: Not described; the team says Devpost blocked its text write-up.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Deck - Sponsor Challenge // Deck - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
The sponsor says its first place went to a solo participant, and this is the only one-person team among its winners.

lessons: A general tool can beat narrow scripts on an automation challenge.
